text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Ah! Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big Bro! Found you!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big Sis! Found you!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! You know,
you always hide right here.
Buu-chan knows all about it!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Before I knew it,
I remembered everything about you.
The things you liked,
the things you disliked.
Even your little habits,
naturally. Everything.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...That was just "normal" to me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, you're still working after all.
Hehe, good work today.
choice_data_list: Were you out running until this ho...
Were you out running until this ho...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
And during my solo practice,
I found this...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! What do you think this is?
choice_data_list: ...Ah! The ice cream we used to ea...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Correct! You loved it,
but we haven't seen it in forever, right?
Apparently they brought it back.
Want to eat it together?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
we ate enough of it for me to remember.
...So,
how is it? Preparing for the trainer seminar.
Pretty tough?
choice_data_list: Well, to be honest... I'm pretty n...
Well, to be honest... I'm pretty n...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Hey,
is there anything I can do to help?
Just say the word!
I'll do my best right alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's see,
this must be the room for the trainer
seminar...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...They said they were nervous, so
I wonder if they're okay...?
Maybe I can peek in just for a second—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Ah, there they are!
—Wait,
looks like they're talking to another
trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Long time no see! How've you been?!
Huh? How long has it been anyway?
Feels like forever, doesn't it?!
choice_data_list: You say that every single time we ...
You say that every single time we ...

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Gaha ha! Getting sick of it already?
Whoa, stop. Don't give me that look!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: They make expressions like that too...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...That's rare...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...The seminar started.
To think Trainer is the very first one to
present, though...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's watching. It's so quiet...
Ngh, good luck...!)

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...A question regarding that training
regimen.
Setting aside the strain on the legs,
how are you approaching the transition
period?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (...Ngh, what a sharp question...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Having to give a proper answer on the spot
in front of all these people...!)
choice_data_list: Yes, allow me to explain that point.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...!
H-Huh...? They seem totally fine...?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Um, that presentation earlier was so
insightful...!
I was wondering if I could consult you about
something... Would that be okay?!
choice_data_list: Sure thing, feel free to message m...

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Word is there's drinks after this!
You're coming, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Drinks—...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...So that's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe,
I guess it makes sense when you think about
it.
It's not like we've been together the whole
time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
There will be things I don't know,
and expressions I've never seen—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Expressions... I'd never seen before...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Big brother.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Big sister.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Did you go far away...?
